text_block_list.text:
Rather than a showdown with her rival, 
Vodka chose her dream: the Nippon Derby.

Upon her entrance, a stir mixing 
anticipation and disdain rises from the 
crowd, while the competing Umamusume cast 
cold glares her way.

However, Vodka paid none of that any mind; 
determined to show off her true, genuine 
way of life, she took on the challenge of 
her dream race.
